'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Tom Hollingsworth DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingsworth]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck title HD. Nana Jule (V) may redlink (OCR). Remote Terminal shield → Reactor Terminal (V).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingsworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out From The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
